_note: Provider data. Last checked against the vendors' pages: 2026-10-28. 'verified' means we tried it live, not only read it in the docs.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.note: Data is processed in China, training is intended. Search and fetch API are paid from 2026-11-01. Do not send personal data.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.note: Default and small tier z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (cheap), strong tier z-ai/glm-5.3. Choose another model with --model (name from the OpenRouter catalog). According to the Claude Code docs only Anthropic is guaranteed as a provider; other models work but are not guaranteed. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is passed to the run empty.

providers.name: Kimi (Moonshot)
providers.note: According to the vendor docs, not tested. All model tiers are set, otherwise background tasks fail silently.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.note: Data stays on the machine. The model needs tool support and at least 64k context. No web search. Minimum Ollama version not documented.

providers.name: EUrouter
providers.note: Speaks the Anthropic format too (/v1/messages), so Claude Code runs on it directly. Claude Code puts the environment block into a message with the role system, which EUrouter rejects; claude_env switches that off (CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES). Live tested with glm-5.3. Any model of the EUrouter catalog works with --model (glm-5.3 is the default, glm-5.3-flash the small tier). The EU hosts differ per model; the response header names the host. Not every host fits personal data: check https://api.eurouter.ai/api/v1/providers.

providers.name: Nvidia NIM
providers.note: Chat completions only. Use with --runner opencode or Claude Code through the LiteLLM extra (--via-litellm). Free-tier terms not documented.

providers.name: Claude with another account
providers.note: Another account means its own quotas. An API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) is recommended. Whether an unattended run with a subscription token (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) is permitted under Anthropic's terms is not documented. Omni-Agent never stores this token.

providers.name: OpenAI via Codex login
providers.note: Uses the login of the Codex CLI itself (codex login, ChatGPT account or API key), no key in Omni-Agent. Consumes the quota of that account. Models: see ~/.codex/models_cache.json or pick freely with --model.
